data.name: Ice Cream Express
data.detailed_description:
Start your engine and bring delicious ice cream to the streets in Ice Cream Express, an ice cream truck simulation game where you create, craft, and sell your own frozen treats.

Drive through the neighborhood with your ice cream truck, discover the best places to stop, and serve customers looking for something sweet. Every order is a chance to prepare a tasty creation using different flavors, cones, toppings, and ingredients.

Craft a wide variety of ice creams, experiment with recipes, and build a menu full of colorful frozen desserts. From classic cones to creative combinations, your truck becomes a mobile dessert shop where every treat is made fresh and served with style.

As your business grows, you can unlock new ingredients, expand your recipes, improve your truck, and become the neighborhood’s favorite ice cream stop.
